about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Sicilian Orange, Olive and Red Onion Salad
recipes.summary: Juicy orange slices with salty olives, red onion and olive oil, a bright winter side.

items: 4 oranges, peeled and sliced into rounds
1 small red onion, very thinly sliced

steps: Arrange the orange rounds on a platter, overlapping slightly.
Scatter over the onion and olives until evenly spread.
Drizzle with the oil and season with chilli, salt and pepper, then finish with parsley.
notes: Soak the onion slices in cold water for 5 minutes for a milder bite.

recipes.title: Orange and Avocado Salad with Honey Lime Dressing
recipes.summary: Orange segments and creamy avocado over baby leaves with a sweet-sharp dressing.
steps: Whisk the oil, lime juice, honey and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Arrange the spinach, orange, avocado and onion on a platter.
Spoon over the dressing until lightly coated and scatter with pepitas.
notes: Serve straight away so the avocado stays green.

recipes.title: Orange and Mint Winter Citrus Salad
recipes.summary: Orange and lemon segments with mint, honey and a pinch of cinnamon for a fresh start to the day.
steps: Combine the orange and lemon segments in a bowl with any juices.
Drizzle with the honey and toss until lightly coated.
Scatter with mint, cinnamon and pistachios.
notes: Serve chilled with plain yoghurt if you like.

recipes.title: Golden Cauliflower Soup with Toasted Cumin Seeds
recipes.summary: Caramelised cauliflower blended with potato and cumin into a nutty, velvety soup.
steps: Heat the oven to 210C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the cauliflower with 2 tbsp oil, the cumin and salt and roast for 25 minutes, until deeply golden at the edges.
Warm the remaining oil in a pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Add the potato, stock and roasted cauliflower and simmer for 15 minutes, until the potato is soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the milk and season.
notes: Keep a few roasted florets aside to garnish.

recipes.title: Broccoli and Cheddar Soup
recipes.summary: A creamy broccoli soup with melted cheddar, a cold-weather favourite.
steps: Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft, adding the garlic for the final minute.
Add the broccoli, potato and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until the vegetables are very tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the milk and cheese until melted.
Season with pepper and serve hot.
notes: Do not boil after adding the cheese or the soup may split.

recipes.title: Rosemary Cannellini and Kale Soup with Carrot
recipes.summary: Tuscan-style soup of kale, cannellini beans, tomato and rosemary.

items: 400g tin cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
150g kale, stems removed and leaves torn

steps: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, until soft, adding the garlic and rosemary for the last minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until the flavours blend.
Stir in the kale and simmer for 5 minutes, until tender.
Season and serve with a drizzle of oil.
notes: Mash some of the beans against the pot for a thicker soup.

recipes.title: Savoy Cabbage Slaw with Orange and Sesame
recipes.summary: A crunchy winter slaw tossed in an orange and mustard dressing.
steps: Whisk the orange juice, oil, vinegar, mustard, honey, sesame seeds and seasoning in a large bowl.
Add the cabbage, carrot and orange.
Toss for 1 minute until everything is coated, then stand for 10 minutes until the cabbage softens slightly.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

recipes.title: Spice-Rubbed Whole Cauliflower with Lemon Tahini and Pomegranate
recipes.summary: A blistered whole cauliflower with spice rub, lemony tahini and pomegranate.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray with baking paper.
Rub the cauliflower with the oil, cumin, paprika and salt and place on the tray.
Roast for 50 minutes, until deep golden and a knife slides easily into the centre.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water until smooth and pourable.
Spoon the tahini over the cauliflower and finish with pomegranate and parsley.
notes: Add more water to the tahini if it thickens.

recipes.title: Glazed Broccoli Tips with Mustard and Honey
recipes.summary: Broccoli roasted until the tips crisp, glazed with honey mustard.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the broccoli with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and roast for 15 minutes, until charred at the tips.
Whisk the mustard, honey, lemon juice and remaining oil.
Toss the hot broccoli with the glaze until glossy.
notes: Not suitable for babies under 12 months because of the honey.

recipes.title: Slow Red Cabbage with Grated Apple and Orange Juice
recipes.summary: Sweet and sour red cabbage slowly braised with apple and a hint of orange.
steps: Warm the oil in a large pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the cabbage, apple, vinegar, sugar, orange juice, cinnamon and water and stir to combine.
Cover and braise on low for 45 minutes, stirring now and then, until the cabbage is very tender and glossy.
Season and serve warm, tasting until the sweet and sour balance is right.
notes: Tastes better the next day and keeps for 4 days.

recipes.title: Kale Caesar Style Salad with Crunchy Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Massaged kale with a creamy lemon dressing and crisp roasted chickpeas.

items: 300g kale, stems removed and leaves finely shredded

steps: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray with baking paper.
Toss the chickpeas with the oil and paprika and roast for 20 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Whisk the yoghurt, lemon juice, mustard, garlic and cheese into a dressing.
Massage the kale with the dressing for 2 minutes, until it softens and darkens.
Top with the chickpeas and pepper.
notes: Dry the chickpeas well before roasting so they crisp.

recipes.title: Quick Lemon Pickle for Rice and Curries
recipes.summary: A tangy, mildly spiced lemon pickle you can make in a saucepan in minutes.

items: 4 lemons, diced with skin on and seeds removed

steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the mustard seeds for 1 minute until they pop.
Add the lemon, turmeric, chilli, sugar, salt and water.
Simmer for 8 minutes, until the lemon is tender and the liquid is syrupy.
Cool and spoon into a clean jar.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks. Strong, so serve in small spoonfuls.

recipes.title: Ginger Carrot Soup Brightened with Orange Zest
recipes.summary: Sweet carrot, fresh ginger and orange juice for a sunny winter soup.
steps: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the onion and ginger for 5 minutes, until soft and fragrant.
Add the carrots and stock and simmer for 20 minutes, until the carrots are very soft.
Blend until smooth and stir in the orange juice and zest.
Season and reheat until steaming.
notes: Freezes for 3 months.

recipes.title: Roast Cauliflower and Cheese Gratin
recipes.summary: Cauliflower baked in a mustardy cheese sauce with a crumb topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and grease a baking dish.
Steam the cauliflower for 6 minutes, until just tender, then arrange in the dish.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk gradually and stir for 5 minutes, until thickened.
Stir in the mustard and half the cheese until melted and season.
Pour over the cauliflower, top with crumbs and remaining cheese and bake for 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
notes: Make ahead and bake just before serving.

recipes.title: Roast Cabbage Wedges with Caraway
recipes.summary: Cabbage wedges roasted until the edges char and the centres turn sweet.

items: 1 small green cabbage, cut into 8 wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 210C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Brush the wedges with the oil and sprinkle with caraway, salt and pepper.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until the edges are charred and the centres are tender.
Drizzle with the vinegar and serve.
notes: Add a spoonful of mustard on the side.

recipes.title: Orange and Yoghurt Breakfast Bowl with Pomegranate
recipes.summary: Thick yoghurt with orange segments, pomegranate and pistachios.
steps: Divide the yoghurt among two bowls, stirring until smooth.
Top with the orange segments, pomegranate seeds and pistachios.
Drizzle with honey and finish with cinnamon.
notes: Not suitable for babies under 12 months because of the honey.

recipes.title: Orange Vinaigrette for Winter Salads
recipes.summary: A glossy orange and Dijon dressing that lifts bitter leaves and roast vegetables.
steps: Combine the orange juice, vinegar, mustard and honey in a jar.
Add the oil, seal and shake until thick and emulsified.
Season to taste, shaking until the dressing is well blended.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 5 days.

recipes.title: Garlicky Tahini Drizzle with Fresh Lemon
recipes.summary: A smooth, tangy sauce for roasted vegetables, falafel and grain bowls.
steps: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt in a bowl; it will seize and thicken.
Add the water a splash at a time, whisking until smooth and pourable.
Finish with the oil and whisk until the sauce is glossy.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 5 days; stir in more water if it thickens.

recipes.title: Raw Broccoli Stem Slaw
recipes.summary: Shaved broccoli stems and carrot in a creamy yoghurt dressing that makes use of the whole broccoli.
steps: Whisk the yoghurt, vinegar, honey, mustard and seasoning in a large bowl.
Add the broccoli, carrot, sultanas and sunflower seeds.
Toss until coated and chill for 10 minutes until the flavours blend.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 days. Not suitable for babies under 12 months because of the honey.

recipes.title: Kale and Potato Soup with Smoked Paprika
recipes.summary: Spanish-style kale and potato soup with a smoky kick.

items: 200g kale, stems removed and leaves shredded

steps: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft, adding the garlic and paprika for the last minute.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Mash a few potatoes against the pot for body, then add the kale and simmer for 5 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the vinegar and season.
notes: Drizzle with olive oil to serve.

recipes.title: Beetroot Wedge Salad with Walnuts and Orange
recipes.summary: Earthy roast beetroot with orange segments, walnuts and goat's cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and wrap the beetroot in foil.
Roast for 50 minutes, until a knife slides easily into the centre, then cool, peel and cut into wedges.
Whisk the oil, orange juice, vinegar and seasoning.
Toss the beetroot, rocket and orange with the dressing and top with walnuts and goat's cheese.
notes: Wear gloves to peel the beetroot to avoid staining.

recipes.title: Coriander and Lime Dressing
recipes.summary: A fresh, zesty dressing for noodle salads, slaws and grilled fish.

items: 1 bunch coriander, leaves and stems chopped

steps: Blend the coriander, lime juice, oil, fish sauce, honey, chilli and garlic until smooth.
Taste and adjust with more lime or honey until balanced.
Transfer to a jar and chill.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 3 days. Not suitable for babies under 12 months because of the honey.

recipes.title: Winter Greens Frittata with Lemon
recipes.summary: Kale, silverbeet and herbs baked into a thick frittata with a squeeze of lemon.

items: 150g kale, stems removed and leaves chopped

steps: Heat the oven to 180C and warm the oil in an ovenproof frying pan.
Cook the leek for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the kale and silverbeet and cook for 4 minutes, until wilted.
Whisk the eggs, cheese, zest and seasoning and pour over the greens.
Cook for 3 minutes, until the edges set, then bake for 15 minutes, until puffed and cooked through in the centre.
Rest for 5 minutes and cut into wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Cauliflower and Potato Curry Soup
recipes.summary: Comforting cauliflower and potato soup with gentle curry spices and coconut milk.
steps: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft, adding the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cauliflower, potato and stock and simmer for 22 minutes, until completely tender.
Blend until smooth and stir through the coconut milk.
Finish with lemon juice and salt.
notes: Do not boil after adding the coconut milk.
